d: Gold Rush takes a wild turn when beavers bring Todd Hoffman's entire mining operation to a standstill by blocking his water supply. Meanwhile, Parker Schnabel's plant relocation turns into an excavator nightmare, and Tony Beets faces a major repair challenge to get his broken dredge running again. With three crews battling unexpected setbacks, who will manage to get back to mining first? Watch Gold Rush, Season 7, Episode 18, on Discovery Channel India.
